sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Deal magic damage (Wind) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 140. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 50 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Heals CP by 10% of max CP every 5 seconds for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals 40% of max HP every 5 seconds for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Nebulous Eclipse (nullifies constant effect skills, applies Grief (10% chance to increase damage received by 50%), increases Ability Power of damage taken while in Break by 50, and increases Ability Power of damage taken from critical hits by 50) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000
Blind and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).

[Aqours] Ruby Kurosawa or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
